reviewer.role: independent bounded CODE configuration/span design reviewer

scope: Read-only design advice for exact JSON/TOML configuration evidence. No source, schema, test, Git, provider, network, Vault or model writes; this artifact does not freeze an interface or dispatch implementation.

installed_runtime.dependency_policy: Do not add YAML/TOML packages, parser plugins, model packages or network clients for this advice; Python >=3.12 supplies tomllib.

legacy_findings.evidence: jcs._serialize accepts exact integers but raises CanonicalJsonError for float values; new evidence must therefore carry every decimal magnitude as a string.
secure_io.parse_strict_json rejects duplicate keys, floats, NaN/Infinity, BOMs and trailing data. It remains the authority for existing integer-JCS artifacts and must not be weakened.

projection_runtime.parse_projection_json intentionally accepts finite floats for derived Docling document artifacts and tags them as ratios; it is not suitable for new config evidence because it admits binary float values.

code_evidence_contracts.normalize_code_bytes preserves strict UTF-8, rejects BOM/control/bare-CR, and computes CRLF-normalized metadata. New config evidence should retain raw bytes/spans in addition to this normalized hash.
staging.py uses stdlib tomllib only to read the bounded pyproject project name. That existing pattern does not interpret arbitrary code/config and supplies no external parser dependency.

staged_code_capture.py consumes caller-provided staged payload bytes and binds raw payload identity through the existing capture/transaction boundary; a config scanner should receive exact bytes from the same host handoff and never fetch paths or execute content.

proposed_contract.purpose: Inspect a bounded host-supplied JSON or practical TOML configuration as data, return exact source locators and typed numeric facts, and let a later reviewed capability proposal cite those locators. Interpretation never proves officiality, execution, training, inference or checkpoint use by itself.

wire_boundary.artifact_jcs_subset: Existing artifact envelopes remain integer-only JCS. No Python float, Decimal object, NaN, Infinity or binary conversion may cross the artifact boundary.
wire_boundary.numeric_policy: Store integer and decimal magnitudes as canonical decimal strings. The original lexeme is retained only as a string and must equal the decoded raw span. Span offsets and limits are bounded integers, so they remain JCS-safe.

input_boundary: Accept exact bytes only from the host observation handoff; do not open arbitrary caller paths, follow URLs, import modules or invoke a loader.
Decode strict UTF-8 once. Reject BOM, invalid UTF-8, unpaired surrogates, forbidden controls and bare CR. Preserve the original bytes and decoded codepoints without NFC/NFKC rewriting.
Compute raw_sha256 over exact bytes. Optionally compute normalized_sha256 after CRLF-to-LF only, matching existing code metadata; normalized identity never substitutes for raw identity.

json.accepted_syntax: RFC 8259 object/array/scalar grammar; SP/TAB/LF/CRLF whitespace only; no comments, trailing commas, JSON5 identifiers or extensions.
json.numeric_grammar: RFC 8259 number grammar; no plus sign, underscores, leading zero, NaN or Infinity.

toml.accepted_subset: TOML 1.0 single-line basic/literal strings, decimal integers, decimal finite floats, booleans, arrays, inline tables, tables and dotted keys.
toml.rejected_subset: Multiline strings, arrays-of-tables, date/time/datetime values, base-prefixed integers, noncanonical leading-zero forms and any syntax outside the frozen subset.

algorithm: Validate the format-specific lexical grammar before Decimal construction.
Remove TOML digit separators only for numeric conversion; retain source_lexeme unchanged.
Construct Decimal from the cleaned lexeme without float(); reject nonfinite values and any bound violation.
Emit integer when the source grammar is an integer; otherwise emit decimal.
Render exact finite Decimal in fixed notation, remove trailing fractional zeroes and redundant leading zeroes, and encode zero as 0; retain source_lexeme so spelling such as 1e-4 remains auditable.
Cross-check canonical value against the parser result; never round or use a Decimal context that changes the value.
rejections: overflow/underflow that produces a nonfinite Decimal
negative-zero lexeme; refuse rather than erase its sign or introduce a second canonical representation.

path_model.syntax: JSON Pointer-style paths, root is empty string, object/table keys escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1, array indices are decimal segments with no leading zero.
path_model.toml_mapping: Dotted TOML keys and table headers map to the same pointer model. Repeated table/key definitions are duplicate paths and refuse; array-of-table paths are outside this subset.
path_model.identity_rule: Paths are based on decoded source strings exactly as supplied; no case folding or Unicode normalization is performed before span/hash binding.

span_model.byte_span: 0-based half-open [byte_start, byte_end) offsets into exact UTF-8 source bytes; raw_span_sha256 hashes precisely those bytes.
span_model.unicode_span: 0-based half-open [unicode_start, unicode_end) offsets into the strict decoded Unicode string before any newline normalization; Python codepoint units, not UTF-16 or grapheme clusters.
span_model.line_columns: 1-based physical line and column; column is decoded codepoint position and end column is exclusive. LF advances one line. CRLF advances one line as a pair; the byte span still includes both bytes. Bare CR refuses.
span_model.containers: JSON containers span opening delimiter through closing delimiter. TOML table headers have header spans; scalar and array/inline-table values have exact value-token spans. A table has no synthetic closing span.
span_model.snippet_binding: A capability locator may carry both raw_span_sha256 and the existing normalized line/snippet hash. Raw bytes prove exact source; normalized hash supports legacy line rendering only.

scanner_cross_check: Bound source bytes and build a line/byte index without changing the source.
Run a format-specific token/stack scanner that emits key, container and scalar spans while enforcing path, depth, count and lexical limits.
For JSON, reject duplicate decoded keys through the scanner and object_pairs_hook; parse_float=Decimal, parse_int=bounded_int and parse_constant=reject_nonfinite. Reject BOM and trailing data.
For TOML, parse_float=bounded_decimal and rely on tomllib duplicate/syntax errors, while the scanner rejects the out-of-subset constructs before typed evidence is emitted.
Project both parser output and scanner nodes to the same path map, compare container shape, scalar type and canonical decimal string, and refuse all typed output on any mismatch.
Validate every emitted span by slicing the original bytes and checking its raw hash, source_lexeme and decoded value. No partial successful interpretation survives a mismatch.

security_rejections.condition: Invalid UTF-8, BOM, unpaired surrogate or forbidden control.
Any byte, depth, node, key, string, array, path, digit, exponent or span budget exceeded.
Duplicate JSON decoded key, TOML key/table collision, or duplicate dotted path.
NaN, Infinity, -Infinity or Decimal result not finite.
Malformed numeric token, out-of-bound exact magnitude or parser/scanner numeric mismatch.
Decoded strings contain explicit ${...}, $(...), {{...}}, }} or %(...) interpolation markers; no environment/template expansion is attempted.
Python/YAML callable tags, !include, !!python, python: loader expressions, or conservative function-call strings matching the frozen callable marker grammar.
Any source slice, path, parser value, raw hash or line/Unicode coordinate disagrees.

interpretation_boundary.verified_status: Only a parser-cross-checked JSON/TOML source with complete typed nodes and exact raw spans may be marked config_data_verified.
interpretation_boundary.source_only_status: Unsupported but safely captured text may be retained as source_text_only_unverified with raw_sha256 and format/reason; it supplies no typed value, capability claim or absence claim.
interpretation_boundary.absence: A capability absence requires a declared search scope and complete observed file inventory. An unfetched path or unsupported config is unverified, never absent.
interpretation_boundary.officiality: Config facts do not establish A/B/C/D officiality. A later relation review must bind repository, full commit, logical path, source_id, and exact capability locators.
interpretation_boundary.execution: No import, eval, exec, subprocess, shell, model load, YAML constructor, interpolation expansion, checkpoint download or network operation is permitted.

evidence_shape.review_binding: Capability proposals reference source_id, repository, commit, path, format, raw_sha256 and one or more exact value-node paths/spans; proposal text remains data and cannot trigger execution.

valid_examples.raw_source:
[optimizer]
name = "AdamW"
learning_rate = 1e-4
betas = [0.9, 0.999]
weight_decay = 0.01

[schedule]
warmup_steps = 1000
gamma = 0.95

valid_examples.span_rule_demonstrated: The Chinese key occupies more UTF-8 bytes than Unicode codepoints; CRLF contributes two raw/codepoint bytes but advances one physical line.

unsupported_examples.reason: YAML is outside the closed parser set; no PyYAML/ruamel dependency and no constructors.
Python source is executable/callable syntax; never import, eval or inspect its AST as configuration.
JSON5 identifiers/trailing comma are outside RFC 8259 JSON.
Explicit interpolation marker; no environment/template expansion.
Conservative callable marker; no execution or callable resolution.
tomllib parse_float=Decimal returns nonfinite Decimal; reject before typed emission.

acceptance_vectors: Exact JSON and TOML nested examples produce identical canonical decimal value 0.0001 for lexeme 1e-4 while preserving distinct raw source spans.
JSON escaped duplicate keys such as {"x":1,"\u0078":2} refuse after decoded-key comparison.
TOML duplicate dotted/table definitions refuse even when spelling differs but decoded path is the same.
CRLF and LF inputs have distinct raw_sha256 and byte spans but equal normalized_sha256 only when bytes differ solely by line endings.
A Unicode key example proves byte offsets are not codepoint offsets; both coordinates must be checked by slicing original bytes and decoded text.
Malformed UTF-8, BOM, bare CR, trailing JSON, comments/trailing commas, depth/node/number limits and parser/scanner disagreements refuse without partial output.
YAML/Python/JSON5/Hydra/INI remain source-text-only and unverified; no dependency, model or execution path is introduced.
Capability evidence must bind repository/full commit/logical config path/source_id/raw_sha256 and exact numeric node path/span; numeric extraction alone cannot assert officiality or capability.
open_design_gates: Architect must choose stable public error-code names before implementation freeze.
Implementation review must add adversarial duplicate/interpolation/callable, CRLF/Unicode, scanner-parser mismatch and no-execution tests before any CODE acceptance.
timestamp_basis: Tool-observed current UTC from date -u; no retrospective review-start time is asserted.
